title: Hangar
description: The legacy-Frame graveyard beyond the six active PC Frames. Singleton file: data/hangar/legacy-units.json.

items.description: Hangar units are legacy Frames (PC-shaped, like the six active ones), not monsters — they don't use creature.schema.json. Most will stay lightweight narrative stubs; frameDataRef is only for a unit fleshed out enough to actually launch (e.g. as a replacement Frame).

frameDataRef.description: id of a full frame.schema.json file for this unit, once it's built out enough to matter mechanically (e.g. as a replacement Frame). Null for a narrative-only stub.
